pages.name: introduction
pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: Review of the national statistical system

elements.name: intro_text
elements.html:
You are invited to complete this self-assessment questionnaire as the first step in the review of the national statistical system of Papua New Guinea.

Your responses will help the review team to understand the strengths and challenges of the system and to identify areas for more in-depth discussion during the review mission.

elements.name: scope_text
elements.html:
Scope of the questionnaire

Please answer the questions, apart from those under part 3, from the perspective of the national statistical system as a whole. This includes the national statistical office and all other producers of official statistics.

elements.name: structure_text
elements.html:
Structure

  • Part 1 – Institutional issues: legal framework, professional independence, safeguarding statistical confidentiality.
  • Part 2 – National statistical system: members, coordinations, access to administrative data and user consultation.
  • Part 3 - National Statistical Office: organization, resources, dissemination, stakeholders, international cooperation, data sources and quality assurance.
  • Part 4 – Main statistical subject-matter domains: assessment of key statistical activities.
  • Part 5 – Supporting documents: Links to relevant laws, strategies, policies, and other background material.

elements.name: guidance_text
elements.html:
How to answer

  • Responses should be concise but informative. Bullet points are acceptable.
  • If an issue or statistical domain is not applicable, please briefly explain why.
  • If information is not available at the time of completing the questionnaire, please indicate this.

elements.name: documents_text
elements.html:
Supporting documents

In Part 5, links to documents available on websites are preferred. If this is not possible, please create a Google Drive folder and share the link.

elements.name: export_text
elements.html:
Download Word report

At the top of this page you can download a Word version of your responses.
